Ana (All-Hands): Follow-up from today's all-hands reliability segment. Drop questions and links to follow-up PRs/issues here; I'll summarize for leadership.

Tess (CTO): RCA: https://internal.redwood/rca/INC-2026-0602
One-line: routing table regression + autoscaler headroom misconfiguration during a traffic surge, fallback didn't engage.

Marta (SRE): Can we get the exact list of mitigations we applied during the incident?

Diego (Platform): Mitigations: reverted routing change, forced traffic to stable variant, temporarily increased regional headroom. I will own a follow-up to gate autoscale changes.

Marta (SRE): I'll add a brief oncall playbook snippet for the runbook. Draft below:
```
Trigger: >25% P95 increase + fallback not firing
Checks: router diff (last 5), autoscale headroom, model-variant map
Immediate: revert router change, force-route stable variant, scale headroom
Post: attach logs and link RCA
```

Lina (CS): ETA for customer note? We need wording for AEs about Dedicated customers.

Ana (All-Hands): Drafting now. Suggested line from product: "Dedicated pools were isolated and not impacted; hosted customers using default routing may have experienced increased latency." I'll post draft in #customer-comms in 3 hours.

Tess (CTO): Owners and ETAs:
- Router-diff CI validation 90 owner: Marta 90 ETA: 7 days
- Gate autoscaler changes with canaries 90 owner: Diego 90 ETA: 10 days
- Warm fallback capacity plan 90 owner: Platform/Infra 90 ETA: 2 weeks
- Runbook update + oncall walkthrough 90 owner: Marta 90 ETA: 4 days

Diego (Platform): PR opened for autoscale gating: https://git.internal/redwood/platform/pulls/4680
